[attribute-end_date]
=== `@end_date` NISO ALI End Date

Date on which the document stops being “free-to-read” or ends the given license, as defined in _NISO Access License and Indicators_ (ALI) NISO RP-22-2015.

#### Usage/Remarks
##### Best Practice

NISO RP-22-2015 recommends that the end date be given in the ISO 8601 format “YYYY-MM-DD”, without inclusion of a time or a time zone.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-ali-free_to_read,`<ali:free_to_read>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The ISO 8601 date on which this standards  document stops being “free-to-read”. If
                        this attribute
                        is not used, the absence indicates that the document is permanently “free-to-read”.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
